prerequisites.title: Install build prerequisites
commands: sudo apt install -y build-essential cmake rpm
notes: Required for building TrustEdge from source.

install.title: Install TrustEdge .deb package
notes: Replace <version> with the actual version string, e.g., 24.7.2-5230.

tpm_provision.title: Provision TPM2 device
notes: Assumes TPM device is /dev/tpm0; adjust if different.

cert_selfsigned.title: Generate self‑signed ML‑DSA certificates
commands: sudo trustedge certificate -a QS -g MLDSA_44 -o CA.pem -x CA.pem -i ca_csr.cnf -da 3651
sudo trustedge certificate -a QS -g MLDSA_44 -o server.pem -x server.pem -i server_csr.cnf -da 3651 -sk CA.pem -sc CA.pem
notes: Uses the QS algorithm with MLDSA_44 post‑quantum signature.

cert_est.title: EST enrollment example
commands: trustedge certificate est --algorithm ECC --curve P256 --uri ${EST_URI} --csr-conf sample_est_csr.conf --key-alias eccTestKey --log-level INFO
notes: Replace ${EST_URI} with the actual EST endpoint.

cert_scep.title: SCEP enrollment example
commands: trustedge certificate scep --scepc-serverURL ${SCEP_ENDPOINT} --scepc-serverType GEN_POST --csr-conf sample_scep_csr.cnf --algorithm RSA --size 2048 --key-alias myGenTap --scepc-challengePass ${SCEP_PASS} --scepc-pkiOperation PKCSReq --tap
notes: Replace ${SCEP_ENDPOINT} and ${SCEP_PASS} with real values.

run_cli.title: Run basic TrustEdge CLI commands
notes: Shows global usage and version.

run_agent.title: Configure and start the TrustEdge agent
notes: Replace <guid.zip> with the bootstrap zip file provided by Device Trust Manager.

pqc_demo.title: Run PQC MQTT demo (subscriber and publisher)
notes: Assumes the MQTT broker is already running with the generated certificates.

verify.title: Verify generated certificates
notes: Prints certificate details in a readable form.
